==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* He was born in Bruges and he is half-Brazilian, as his mother and part of his family are from [[wikipedia:en:Belo Horizonte|Belo Horizonte]], in Brazil.<ref>[https://youtu.be/u-PfzLUmd64?t=2281 League News BR: May 16, 2018 (Portuguese/Video)] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* He loves videogames since he was a kid, as was told by his brother in a interview. They always played games together, and his brother introduced him to League of Legends.<ref>[https://x.com/ilhadaslendas/status/1893438867476230454 Ilha das Lendas' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* His summoner name originates from his cat, who was named Pipo. As a kid he was playing a game with friends and kept trying different variations of Pipo until something wasn’t taken, and that was Bwipo.
* He achieved Challenger when he was about 13-14 years old.
* Known for the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-0HS2S8Facc Wide Bwipo meme] which originated from his [[Fnatic]] days.
* He was awarded the prize of "''Esports PC Rookie of the Year''" at the Esports Awards in 2018.<ref>[https://twitter.com/esportsawards/status/1062094105075945474 Esports Awards' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* Switched to bot lane briefly in the [[EU LCS/2018 Season/Summer Season|EU LCS 2018 Summer]] as [[Fnatic]] had two top laners and [[Rekkles]] was unwilling to play the then-meta bot lane bruisers and mages. 
* Often rumored to have a rivalry with [[sOAZ]] when they were teammates.
* Known for his talkative personality. 
* Has often appeared on LEC broadcasts as a guest commentator and many fans tout him as a future LEC caster.
* Part of a select group of players called "Royal Roaders", earned after winning their rookie split in a major region (EU LCS Spring 2018)
* He revealed in an interview that he received $1.5 million for his 3-year contract in [[Fnatic]].
* After the end of the first week of [[LTA/2025 Season/Split 1 Playoffs|LTA Playoffs]] in Brazil, where all [[LTA South]] teams were eliminated, he offered to help local players with individual coaching, such as [[Brance]].<ref>[https://x.com/Bwipo/status/1891339088483037637 Bwipo's X Post] ''x.com''</ref><ref>[https://x.com/brancelol01/status/1891535361102225464 Brance's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
=== Individual Awards ===
* LCS 1st All-Pro Team x1 (2024 Spring)
* LCS 3rd All-Pro Team x3 (2022 Spring, 2022 Summer, 2024 Summer)
* LEC 2nd All-Pro Team x2 (2018 Summer, 2020 Spring)
* LEC 3rd All-Pro Team x3 (2019 Summer, 2021 Spring, 2021 Summer)
